title: Grateful Dead Live at Merriweather Post Pavilion on 1985-07-01
lineage: Master Cassette (Nakamichi DR-1)> Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz) > dBpoweramp 24/96 > Adobe Audition CC 2014 > TLH flac2496
source: Mike Guy & Jim Pailes's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi CM300 mics w/ CP-4 shotgun caps > Sony D5M (Maxell XLIIS-90)

ai_review.summary: Recording plagued by corrupt FLAC files, rendering it unlistenable and leaving the show quality unknown
ai_review.review: The sole reviewer reports that a large portion of the FLAC files are corrupted, making playback impossible until fixed. Because the audio cannot be heard, no assessment of the musical performance or setlist can be made.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review focusing on file corruption; recording is effectively unusable and there is no information about the show itself.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple corrupt FLAC files reported; playback issues prevent evaluation of clarity or mix.
